name: 4seas.io
description:
4Seas is an Ethereum cultural community and permanent Zuzalu hub in Chiang Mai, Thailand. 4Seas has two campuses (4Seas Nimman and 4Seas Mountain View). These campuses serve as a living lab to test network state concepts like decentralized governance and public goods funding.

Through coliving and popups, 4Seas provides a base for digital and crypto nomads to build new technologies. The community hosts diverse events covering open source tech, AI, and cypherpunk topics.

4Seas

A permanent node of the Zuzalu movement. Based in Chiang Mai, Thailand.

Learn more
About 4Seas

4Seas is an Ethereum cultural community and permanent Zuzalu hub in Chiang Mai, Thailand. 4Seas has two campuses (4Seas Nimman and 4Seas Mountain View). These campuses serve as a living lab to test network state concepts like decentralized governance and public goods funding.

Through coliving and popups, 4Seas provides a base for digital and crypto nomads to build new technologies. The community hosts diverse events covering open source tech, AI, and cypherpunk topics.

name: Akiya Collective
description:
Akiya Collective transforms abandoned rural Japanese houses (akiya) into creative residencies and community hubs. Addressing Japan's vacant home crisis, they acquire and renovate properties to foster art, communal living, and innovation.

Since acquiring its first property in Komoro, Nagano in 2024, the collective has grown to steward multiple homes and support community-purchased satellite properties, blending international creatives with local residents.

Akiya Collective

Learn more
About Akiya Collective

Akiya Collective transforms abandoned rural Japanese houses (akiya) into creative residencies and community hubs. Addressing Japan's vacant home crisis, they acquire and renovate properties to foster art, communal living, and innovation.

Since acquiring its first property in Komoro, Nagano in 2024, the collective has grown to steward multiple homes and support community-purchased satellite properties, blending international creatives with local residents.

Timeline
2022

Founding & Early Exploration

Crowdfunded the community and explored 100+ akiya sites while hosting 3 pilot residencies before nonprofit incorporation.

2024

First Property Acquisition

Purchased the first akiya in Komoro, Nagano.

2025

Makerspace Growth

Expanded the makerspace and established 10 total properties by facilitating member purchases of 3 new akiya.

2025

Public Launch

Opened the community space to host 50 residents across 15 events and workshops.

2025

Artistic Installations

Created the immersive liminal kimonos installation using sourced materials for Burning Japan.

name: Amagi Life
description:
Amagi Life is building a network of regenerative villages with long-term residents and shared land ownership.

It addresses unaffordable housing and extractive development through shared ownership. Residents earn equity through contribution rather than capital. The first village, Hidden Valley, is in Koh Phangan, Thailand.

name: ArkPad
description:
ArkPad is a seasteading and naval construction company based in the Philippines. The team of naval architects, civil, chemical, aeronautical, and mechanical engineers, along with blockchain developers, create technologies to make floating cities a reality.

ArkPad builds deep sea platforms, mariculture systems, and dApps that fund seasteading communities through decentralized finance. Its projects include the ArkPad-C for coastal living, the Hexafarm for polyculture fish farming, and the Reef Resort, a floating resort with aquaculture and guest facilities.

ArkPad is a seasteading and naval construction company based in the Philippines. The team of naval architects, civil, chemical, aeronautical, and mechanical engineers, along with blockchain developers, create technologies to make floating cities a reality.

ArkPad builds deep sea platforms, mariculture systems, and dApps that fund seasteading communities through decentralized finance. Its projects include the ArkPad-C for coastal living, the Hexafarm for polyculture fish farming, and the Reef Resort, a floating resort with aquaculture and guest facilities.

enrichment.summaryRu: The VMCC Builder DAO website explicitly names City of Atlantus as a project connecting virtual planning with real construction and commercial assets. Its stated mission is to retrain the global workforce and create employment pathways amid automation. It proposes a network of virtual mining and construction companies with business management and asset tokenization tools; large-scale network development is described as a future goal.

additionalDetails: The text lists residential, commercial, and industrial assets.
Builder Workstation is presented as shared access to VMCC business tools.
Creating a VMCC is described as a way to join Builder DAO; the page read does not detail voting procedures.
Promises of returns, NFT value, and uninterrupted platform operation were not verified and were not included as established results.

enrichment.reviewNote: coa.build redirects to vmcc.build; the page explicitly describes City of Atlantus and links to the original app.coa.build. This is a substantive connection to the exact project, not automatic acceptance of a new brand. A built city, real assets, and returns are not confirmed. These are source claims, not independently verified.

name: Ciudad Morazán
description: Ciudad Morazán is a pioneering, 24-hectare charter city near Choloma, Honduras. Founded by Massimo Mazzone, it provides affordable housing, industrial workspaces, and reliable infrastructure. Distinctly focused on local blue-collar workers rather than expats, this self-sustaining community offers private security and customer-focused governance in a historically dangerous region.
sourceText:
Ciudad Morazan - Honduran blue collar startup city
Ciudad Morazan

A startup city in Honduras providing safe housing and modern amenities for blue collar families and entrepreneurs.

Learn more
About Ciudad Morazan

Ciudad Morazán is a pioneering, 24-hectare charter city near Choloma, Honduras. Founded by Massimo Mazzone, it provides affordable housing, industrial workspaces, and reliable infrastructure. Distinctly focused on local blue-collar workers rather than expats, this self-sustaining community offers private security and customer-focused governance in a historically dangerous region.

Timeline
2013

Honduran ZEDE Law

Honduras amends its constitution to create highly autonomous economic zones.

2019

Ciudad Morazán Approved

CAMP (Commission for the Adoption of Best Practices) officially approves the project.

2020

Governance Framework Established

Developers draft Morazán's first laws.

2022

ZEDE Law Repeal

Honduran Congress repeals the ZEDE laws, triggering international arbitration.

2025

Honduran Election

New administration takes office, shaping the future of ZEDE protections.

sections.About Commons Hub:
About Commons Hub

Commons Hub is a coliving and popup venue in the Austrian Alps, an hour from Vienna. It is a home for artists, hackers, and tinkerers exploring new perspectives across technology, economy, society, and nature. The house has makerspaces, gardens, a workshop, and a wood-fired hot tub, with hiking trails and a river nearby.

sourceText:
Culdesac - A walkable city in Arizona
Culdesac

Walkable neighborhoods. Built for belonging, transportation freedom, and thriving local businesses.

Learn more
About Culdesac

Culdesac Tempe is the first car-free neighborhood built from scratch in the United States. It has 17 acres of apartments, local shops, plazas, and paths situated right next to a light rail station in Tempe, Arizona.

20+
Apartment designs
2+ miles
Bike & foot paths
17 acres
Community footprint
Posts

How does the community build connections?
Who it's for

Families
College Students
Timeline
2018

Company Founding

Culdesac is established by Ryan Johnson and Jeff Berens to develop car-free walkable neighborhoods in the US.

Nov 2019

Groundbreaking

Construction begins on Culdesac Tempe, the first project on a 17-acre infill site in Tempe, Arizona.

May 2023

First Residents

Phase one opens and initial residents move into the car-free community.

2025

Community Expansion

Culdesac Tempe reaches over 350 residents and 21 local businesses with additional buildings, mature landscaping, and full amenities operational.

atlas.joinInfo: Apply through their website for assemblies and programs.

dashboard.text:
Forma - A permanent Solana economic zone
Forma

Forma previously hosted popup villages and developed Solana Economic Zones in frontier markets. Now they are building a permanent campus in the UK.

Learn more
About Forma

Forma has hosted popup villages in Argentina, Sri Lanka, and Georgia. Forma has stood out by bridging the Solana Network State with nation states. Their popups have acted as cultural and trade missions for the Solana ecosystem. Notable examples: MOUs with the Kazakh and Georgian governments.

They are now building a campus in the UK.

description: Fractally develops open blockchain tools for autonomous communities and recognition of members' contributions to public goods. name: Free State Project
description: The Free State Project is a political migration movement founded in 2001 by Jason Sorens to recruit libertarians to move to New Hampshire. By concentrating liberty-minded individuals in one low-population state, the movement aims to create a stronghold for libertarian ideas. Over 6,000 'Free Staters' have already moved, with many elected to the 400-member NH House of Representatives.

name: Freedom Haven
description: Freedom Haven presents itself as a humanitarian and commercial floating port-city project for 5,000–10,000 people seeking liberty. The stated plan envisages commissioning construction by 2037 and completion by 2042, followed by permanent placement outside the jurisdiction of existing governments. Ten-year space leases are intended to finance construction, maintenance, crew, and protection.
location: Planned floating port city outside the jurisdiction of existing governments; no specific location stated
sourceText: Bring prosperity of free markets to liberty immigrants.

Transforming a 16-floor tower into a vertical village for frontier tech pioneers in San Francisco.

About Frontier Tower

Frontier Tower is a Zuzalu-inspired vertical village in San Francisco. Alongside the nearby Superhero Hotel for coliving, it forms a unified campus where members live and build. Each floor has its own theme and dedicated lead, with floors for AI, crypto, biotech, longevity, robotics, neurotech, human flourishing, and arts & music.

name: Futura Camp (ZuBerlin)
description:
ZuBerlin has been a mainstay in the Zuzalu ecosystem, having run multiple popups. They recently rebranded to Futura Camp and aim to create a highly curated residency that brings researchers, founders, and technologists together. Held as a temporary village at Funkhaus Berlin, the program blends technical depth with genuine human connection in a coliving environment designed for flourishing.

Participants engage in principled discussions on topics like protocol architecture, cryptography, MEV, sovereign AI, future cities, and more while integrating with onsite partner events during Berlin Blockchain Week.

description:
Gelephu Mindfulness City (GMC) is an emerging startup city and Special Economic Zone in Bhutan. Operating under a One Country, Two Systems model, it will feature independent and business-friendly laws. GMC aims to integrate mindful prosperity with decentralized technology.

Backed by a 10,000 Bitcoin development pledge, GMC has already started to collaborate with startup societies and ecosystems like Edge City, Ethereum, and Solana.

name: Hacker Residency Group
description:
Hacker Residency Group is an experimental one month program in Da Nang that invites ten ambitious founders to live and build together in a villa with ocean views and dedicated workspaces.

It is building a new international dev community for digital nomads built on friendships, focus, and rapid learning. Everything except flights is free: villa, food, laundry, private bedroom and bathroom, workstation, and videographer.

name: Infinita
description:
Infinita City is a network city where founders build towards longevity through biotech, computation, and science. Its first hub sits in Próspera on Roatán, Honduras, inside a special economic zone that offers regulatory speed for biomedical innovation.

The project evolved from the Vitalia popup city. It now runs events, accelerators, and games that bring together builders testing human enhancement tools and protocols. Permanent residents operate funded startups while the community experiments with network societies and infinite play.

name: Ipê City
description:
Ipê City is a community of techno-optimists building social technologies for internet-native cities. The project prototypes governance, coordination, education, identity, and other parallel institutions using AI, blockchain, and decentralized tools in real-world settings.

It operates through popup villages in Florianópolis, Brazil, where builders colive and experiment with new systems. The long-term vision is a permanent network of villages supported by crypto governance and aligned around human progress through technology and freedom.

About Ipê City

Ipê City is a community of techno-optimists building social technologies for internet-native cities. The project prototypes governance, coordination, education, identity, and other parallel institutions using AI, blockchain, and decentralized tools in real-world settings.

It operates through popup villages in Florianópolis, Brazil, where builders colive and experiment with new systems. The long-term vision is a permanent network of villages supported by crypto governance and aligned around human progress through technology and freedom.

name: Isla de LOBOS
description: Isla de Lobos proposes creating a community on a 1,250-hectare island in Uruguay's Río Negro department, at the confluence of the Río Negro and Uruguay rivers. The project envisages 1,000 accommodation units and a permanent 750-hectare nature reserve. Its stated structure combines LOBOS DAO LLC, a Uruguayan trust, voting weighted by staked LOBO$, and a multisignature treasury. Despite ownership wording at the start of the page, the plan section explicitly states that the island has not yet been purchased and that the first 333 members must approve the acquisition.
location: Uruguay, Río Negro department; at the confluence of Río Negro and Río Uruguay
sourceText: To establish a decentralized and 100% sustainable community through the L.O.B.O.S. DAO

facts.location: Uruguay, Río Negro department; at the confluence of Río Negro and Río Uruguay

The contradiction between promotional language describing an island already owned by members and the explicit statement that it has not been purchased is retained. 2026 in the civilizations comparison is not a founding date.

name: Montelibero
description: Montelibero describes itself as an open social experiment testing the global competitive advantages of freedom, non-aggression, voluntary contracts and self-organisation. It runs in three forms: a self-organising movement, the Montelibero Association (described by the project as an extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction), and the MTL Fund, a blockchain DAO managed by an assembly of the twenty largest MTLRECT holders. Its first settlement, MTL City, sits on land bought in the Bar municipality of Montenegro. The project runs its own tokenomics on Stellar — MTL, MTLRECT, the EURMTL stablecoin and a range of issued offers — and states that remote participation is possible without relocating. Figures on this page are the project's own published numbers and are not independently verified.

sections.Goal:
Goal
The main goal of the Montelibero project is to turn Montenegro, Europe and the whole world into a comfortable and safe place for the life and creative work of freedom-loving people, by legally promoting the ideas, norms and practices that protect and expand the personal sovereignty of every adherent of the principle of non-aggression.
sections.Method:
Method
The main method is an open-ended social experiment in the form of a game with a growing sum, in which hypotheses about the viability, attractiveness, scalability and strategic advantage of a social order based on libertarian and panarchic principles, and on the priority of civic self-organisation over any violent forms, are tested.
sections.Forms:
Forms
The activity of the Montelibero project is carried out in three main forms of agency: the movement of the same name, the Association, and the MTL Fund.
The Montelibero movement is a self-organising public movement with no prescribed legal or organisational form; participants are united only by shared goals and principles and are free to choose their own forms and trajectories.
The Montelibero Association is a structure with fixed participation, described by the project as an extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction, intended to raise the effectiveness of the project's goals through greater social cohesion and mutual accountability, without claiming a monopoly on representing the movement.
The MTL Fund is a structure in the form of a blockchain DAO providing organisational, technological and resource support for the project in its early stages, and acting as coordinator, moderator and holder of the project's meanings, values and models.
Montelibero Global is a global network of communities of movement participants, divided into territorial and extraterritorial communities.
sections.Governance of the MTL Fund:
Governance of the MTL Fund
The Fund is managed by an assembly of the 20 largest holders of MTLRECT tokens. Public registers are published for founders, signatories, shareholders by voting weight, and for the decisions of the Signers' Council. The 2026 decision-management regulation sets out an eight-stage procedure: preparation, submission, reading, decision, publication, implementation, documentation and control. A simplified procedure without readings applies to multisignature updates, dividend payouts, token issuance and other matters below a stated threshold of 0.3% of the Fund's current balance.
sections.Remote participation:
Remote participation
The official FAQ of 25 February 2024 states that people who cannot or do not want to relocate to Montenegro may take part: through the media network of more than 200 Telegram chats, through the diaspora subnet, by working on the MTL tokenomics, by taking on IT, management, media or marketing tasks on a voluntary or paid basis, through crypto investment via the MABIZ accelerator or the MTL Fund, and by joining the Montelibero Association as 'citizens of a virtual state' in the form of an extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction.
sections.Self-reported figures:
Self-reported figures
The project's homepage publishes live counters: EURMTL consolidated in the Fund; participants in the Montelibero Association DAO; participants in the Montelibero Fund DAO; EURMTL distributed over the last month; and members of the MTL community on Telegram. These are the project's own published numbers and are not independently verified. The 2025 chronicle and the February 2026 interview report an association of more than 200 registered individual and 70 corporate members, a main channel of more than 4,500 subscribers, and a public 'Agora' chat with more than 700 participants.
sections.MTL City:
MTL City
MTL City is the flagship subproject of the Montelibero project: an operating model of a city-type settlement in Montenegro providing its owners, residents and guests with comfortable living on libertarian principles, norms and practices. The project's own pages list a neighbourliness agreement (the MTL City offer) and a Stellar account, and describe a modular housing quarter developed with Green Zyland.

researchReview.summaryEn: The project's own website, its annual chronicles for 2021–2025, its strategy concept, its Association, Fund, Court, MTL City and Global pages, and its WordPress API were read directly. They describe an open social experiment on voluntary contracts and self-organisation, running in three forms — movement, Association (an extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction) and a blockchain DAO fund — with MTL City as the first settlement in Montenegro, a Stellar-based tokenomics, and documented remote participation. The chronology in this profile is taken from the project's own annual chronicles and event pages.
researchReview.summaryRu: Прочитаны официальный сайт проекта, его летописи за 2021–2025 годы, стратегический концепт, разделы Ассоциации, Фонда, Суда, МТЛ-Сити и Глобального Монтелиберо, а также API WordPress. Проект описан как открытый социальный эксперимент на принципах добровольных контрактов и самоорганизации, работающий в трёх формах — движение, Ассоциация (экстерриториальная контрактная юрисдикция) и блокчейн-DAO-фонд; первое поселение — МТЛ-Сити в Черногории, токеномика построена на Stellar, удалённое участие предусмотрено. Хронология в карточке взята из собственных летописей проекта.

facts.value: Three forms of agency: a self-organising movement, the Montelibero Association described as an extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction, and the MTL Fund as a blockchain DAO managed by an assembly of the 20 largest MTLRECT holders
Decision management in the MTL Fund follows an eight-stage procedure from preparation through control, set out in a regulation adopted by the Signers' Council on 11 May 2026
MTL City stands on land in the Bar municipality of Montenegro: 10,154 m² was acquired in August 2021 and transferred to the local Montelibero company with an entry in the property register
Remote participation is explicitly permitted: community chats, diaspora subnet, work on the tokenomics, IT, management, media and marketing tasks, crypto investment, and membership of the Association

The Association describes itself as an extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction; the project also registered the MONTELIBERO trademark in the European Union in February 2023 and established a local legal entity in Montenegro in June 2021

Project-published counters on the homepage: EURMTL consolidated in the Fund, participants in the Association DAO and the Fund DAO, EURMTL distributed over the last month, and members of the MTL Telegram community

caveats: Every figure on this page is a self-reported project number published by the project itself; none has been independently verified.
The Association's 'extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction' wording is the project's own description, not recognition as a state or independent verification of legal effect.
Photographs are the project's own published media; permission for republication has not been established and they are shown for research identification with the source link retained.
The emblem is a trademark-style project mark (MONTELIBERO trademark registered in the EU in February 2023); it is not a freely licensed asset and no republication permission has been established.
The 2024 chronicle is not published as a standalone annual report; 2024 events in this profile come from the 2025 chronicle and from dated project pages.
The current activity of the project, its membership figures and the legal status of its structures have not been independently verified.
researchReview.contactNote: Published project channels. Destination reachability and message delivery are not independently verified.

name: mtndao
description:
mtndao is a month long residency in Salt Lake City for Solana founders and builders. The program runs through bear markets and bull markets alike, with daily collaboration, sponsor workshops, and shipping pressure.

The residency ends with Demo Day, where dozens of teams present live projects to the Solana community.

links.label:
naruto11eth
@naruto11eth

Actually mtndao fosters that 10x better than any company out there. i have seen it with my own eyes. these were devs who have potential to be great founders and they were building all day long at mtndao from 7am to 2am.

8 Apr 2026

edgarpavlovsky
@edgarpavlovsky

The power of this winter's mtndao came, above all, from the distribution of velocity amongst the community. Velocity's a common feeling at the MTN - that's not new. But usually it's concentrated - you have relatively small groups driving motion at any given time, and the community sustains on that.

11 Mar 2026

name: Network School
description:
Network School is a frontier community for techno-optimists. Members focus daily on learning new skills, maintaining physical fitness, earning income remotely, and building strong friendships.

Founded by Balaji Srinivasan, Network School turns online communities into physical startup societies. It offers society-as-a-service with all-inclusive housing, healthy meals, gym access, and 24/7 coworking spaces. Flexible stays range from one month to a full year.

Founded by Balaji Srinivasan, Network School turns online communities into physical startup societies. It offers society-as-a-service with all-inclusive housing, healthy meals, gym access, and 24/7 coworking spaces. Flexible stays range from one month to a full year.

Nomad

Accommodation for the modern nomad. Coliving villages from the future.

Learn more
About Nomad

Nomad is a global coliving ecosystem built for modern nomads. They provide modular NODE homes that members can rent, build, license, or buy.

V1 is operational in Raleigh and V2 is under construction in Roatán (at Próspera).

name: Proof of Humanity
description: The Proof of Humanity page, signed Democracy Earth, describes verifying a unique human through Self and a passport-based zero-knowledge proof. The stated process issues a nontransferable ERC-721/ ERC-5192 credential containing an anonymous identifier and an approximate 90-day validity window rather than passport data. The presented release candidate is limited to the Base Sepolia testnet; the credential is proposed for voting, token distributions, and basic income on a one-claim-per-person basis. For additional checks of age, citizenship, or sanctions status, v1 relies on an issuer that evaluates private information and sends the recipient a signed yes/no response.
sourceText: Building decentralized democracy using social verification

name: Proto-Town
description:
Proto-Town is a 1200-acre ranch and hardware incubator located in Lockhart, Texas. Proto-Town combines housing, machine shops, testing grounds, and manufacturing facilities at a single address.

Founders live on-site to build and test physical technologies, including autonomous bulldozers, drones, robotics, and nuclear research equipment. Early-stage startups pay for room and board, while established companies lease land for scaled testing. The project is designed to be a dense American manufacturing ecosystem operating as a frontier outpost for physical production.

description: In Brian Colwell's June 24, 2024 publication, PUNK Armada DAO is described as a Network Union with voting power attached to PUNK Armada NFTs. The same text names PUNK 4762 as the recognized founder of the initiative. This is a historical self-description: the original cryptopunk4762.com now shows an expired-domain page, and the saved Linktree does not confirm current DAO operation.
sourceText: Establish a global voluntary citizenry.

enrichment.summaryRu: In Brian Colwell's June 24, 2024 publication, PUNK Armada DAO is described as a Network Union with voting power attached to PUNK Armada NFTs. The same text names PUNK 4762 as the recognized founder of the initiative. This is a historical self-description: the original cryptopunk4762.com now shows an expired-domain page, and the saved Linktree does not confirm current DAO operation.

additionalDetails: The PUNKArmadaDAO Linktree contains links to the About section and technical texts on the original cryptopunk4762.com.
The publication connects NFTs with voting power but does not describe quorum, counting, or decision implementation.
The name Sovereign Organization For Sovereign Population is a self-definition, not recognition of sovereignty.
facts.governance: According to the June 24, 2024 publication: DAO governance voting power is attached to PUNK Armada NFTs; the current procedure was not checked.

enrichment.reviewNote: Linktree connects the exact name with the original domain, and the dated publication adds substantive information beyond a link list. The platform and actual voting were not checked. These are source claims, not independently verified.

name: RNS.ID
description:
RNS.ID is the official technology provider for the Republic of Palau Digital Residency Program. Members receive a legally recognized government-issued identification card alongside a soulbound NFT on the blockchain.

The Palau ID supports KYC and identity verification for crypto exchanges, banks, hotels, flights, rentals, and everyday services. Applicants who pass screening obtain both a digital onchain credential and a physical plastic card mailed globally.
sourceText:
RNS.ID - Government issued digital residency
RNS.ID

A digital residency program backed by the Republic of Palau.

Learn more
About RNS.ID

RNS.ID is the official technology provider for the Republic of Palau Digital Residency Program. Members receive a legally recognized government-issued identification card alongside a soulbound NFT on the blockchain.

The Palau ID supports KYC and identity verification for crypto exchanges, banks, hotels, flights, rentals, and everyday services. Applicants who pass screening obtain both a digital onchain credential and a physical plastic card mailed globally.

151
Eligible countries
+180 Days
Stay per entry
0%
Non-Palau tax
Posts
Frequently asked questions
What are the benefits of the Palau ID?
What are the eligibility requirements?
What is the pricing and renewal process?
Who it's for
Digital Nomads
Web3 Founders
Global Freelancers
Crypto traders
Timeline
Dec 2021

Digital Residency Act

Palau passes legislation and signs exclusive contract with RNS for the digital residency program.

Jan 2022

Program Launch

Republic of Palau announces the world's first sovereign-backed digital residency platform at rns.id.

Feb 2022

Inauguration Ceremony

President Surangel Whipps Jr. hosts event naming Tim Draper as the founding digital resident.

2023–2024

Blockchain Expansion

Platform issues Legal Digital IDs on Ethereum and Solana with zkSync support for onchain KYC.

2025+

Voyager Pass Rollout

Enhanced benefits added including travel discounts and priority access for existing residents.

name: The Anthem Initiative
description: Anthemism advocates creating a sovereign state of free capitalism based on Objectivism and Ayn Rand's philosophy. Its roadmap aims at a full-fledged country, not a micro-enclave, and proposes seeking territory that could eventually accommodate at least ten million people. The first described stage includes networking with politicians, diplomats, entrepreneurs, and intellectuals; materials on southern Lebanon and the Cyprus buffer zone are presented as hypothetical studies, not acquired territories.

name: The Mu
description:
The Mu is one of the longest running popup village organizers. They originally ran popups in emerging economies with a focus on bringing blockchain opportunities to those locations. Their most recent iteration is focusing on robotics and AI and creating a bridge for people who want to experience China.

The Mu community prioritizes open source development, a doer mentality, long-term thinking, and positive-sum outcomes. Events connect global participants with local tech ecosystems through unconference-style workshops, factory tours, hackathons, and cultural immersion.

links.label:
Nathan Cheng
@realNathanCheng

Cool china gateway popup in Shanghai happening in May. There's also a longevity/biotech theme week.

17 Mar 2026

Koko
@kokebsolomon

Are you like me? Endlessly curious about the country behind it all? Most have consumed everything China produces. Almost none have gone to understand how OR the culture that made it that way. MuShanghai is the month that closes that gap.

22 Apr 2026

JB of Lagos
@_jboflagos

I travelled to Ghana for the first time to participate in Mu Accra. I'm super grateful to Pishikeni who helped with the information and it was a great experience to share the same space with amazing builders from across the continent.

25 Dec 2024

About Traditional Dream Factory

Traditional Dream Factory (TDF) is a regenerative village in Portugal that transformed a former poultry farm into a coliving campus that restores land.

Web3 tools power governance through a DAO structure and $TDF tokens. The model blends agroforestry, rewilding, and hospitality.

Timeline
2021

Keys to the farm

Acquired former poultry farm and launched basic infrastructure with glamping, solar power, and initial tree planting.

2022

Operational coliving

Built food forest, sauna, coworking barn, and DAO prototype.

2023

Token launch

Installed Starlink, expanded glamping and volunteer beds, and launched the booking platform and $TDF tokens.

2024

Water infrastructure

Raised €400K private debt and broke ground on a natural swimming pool and rainwater systems.

2025

Build out phase

Upgraded facilities, advanced mushroom farm, and completed the masterplan.

2026

Hospitality completion

Constructing en suite rooms, a restaurant, and studios while finalizing cohousing permits.

Traditional Dream Factory - Regenerative web3 village in Portugal
Traditional Dream Factory

A regenerative coliving village in Portugal.

Learn more
About Traditional Dream Factory

Traditional Dream Factory (TDF) is a regenerative village in Portugal that transformed a former poultry farm into a coliving campus that restores land.

Web3 tools power governance through a DAO structure and $TDF tokens. The model blends agroforestry, rewilding, and hospitality.

Keys to the farm

Acquired former poultry farm and launched basic infrastructure with glamping, solar power, and initial tree planting.

2022

Operational coliving

Built food forest, sauna, coworking barn, and DAO prototype.

2023

Token launch

Installed Starlink, expanded glamping and volunteer beds, and launched the booking platform and $TDF tokens.

2024

Water infrastructure

Raised €400K private debt and broke ground on a natural swimming pool and rainwater systems.

2025

Build out phase

Upgraded facilities, advanced mushroom farm, and completed the masterplan.

2026

Hospitality completion

Constructing en suite rooms, a restaurant, and studios while finalizing cohousing permits.

name: Union X City
description: Union X City claims a city project on the coast of Vancouver Island in Canada, focused on both human connections and technological innovation. The website names an initial 789-acre site and describes it as a space for future development. The wording 'coming to life' does not confirm that the city has been built, populated, or given a separate legal status.
location: Vancouver Island coast, Canada — claimed project site
sourceText: To build a human-first city operating system leveraging frontier tech

name: Užupis
description: In the separable substantive portion of the original website, the Republic of Užupis is described as a collective cultural, artistic, civic, and social movement of the local Vilnius community. Its self-description emphasizes living together and the connection between freedom and responsibility. The saved page contains unrelated spam; only identifiable statements about Užupis were used, without treating the website as a reliable source of legal sovereignty.
location: Užupis, Vilnius, Lithuania — cultural community according to the saved excerpt
sourceText: To create a space for freedom, creativity, and self-expression.

internetCSV.name: Užupis
internetCSV.mission: To create a space for freedom, creativity, and self-expression.

enrichment.summaryRu: In the separable substantive portion of the original website, the Republic of Užupis is described as a collective cultural, artistic, civic, and social movement of the local Vilnius community. Its self-description emphasizes living together and the connection between freedom and responsibility. The saved page contains unrelated spam; only identifiable statements about Užupis were used, without treating the website as a reliable source of legal sovereignty.

additionalDetails: The saved MCP excerpt explicitly names the local community, Vilnius, and Lithuania.
The browser text includes the principle 'Freedom without responsibility is not possible.'
Menu links to parliament and citizenship alone do not confirm a governance system or citizenship rights.
Spam inserts were fully excluded from the description and facts; the disputed independence date on the page was not used.
facts.location: Užupis, Vilnius, Lithuania — cultural community according to the saved excerpt

enrichment.reviewNote: evidence/uzupis-mcp-0.json and the contaminated evidence/uzupis-1.json were read; the actual URL is the HTTP version of the original domain, not a successfully read HTTPS citizenship page. The name and local cultural movement match the CSV; legal implications were not established. These are source claims, not independently verified.

sourceText:
Vibecamp - Festival for internet communities
Vibecamp

A recurring IRL festival for the TPOT (This Part Of Twitter) cloud community.

Learn more
About Vibecamp

Born from "TPOT" (This Part of Twitter), Vibecamp is a recurring festival that transforms digital connections into real-world community. Combating modern isolation, it gathers adults to play, build, and connect through high-agency, decentralized activities. Emphasizing "fierce friendliness" and deep conversation, Vibecamp inspires attendees to seed playful local communities back home.

100+
Activities
4
Vibecamps hosted
2022
Founded
Posts
Frequently asked questions
Where is Vibecamp?
When is Vibecamp?
Are meals provided at Vibecamps?
Can I bring my child?
Who it's for
TPOT community
Post-Rats
Digital Nomads
Timeline
2021

The Twitter Origin

Started as a collective internet "hyperstition".

2022

Vibecamp 1

Inaugural in-person gathering at Camp Champions in Austin, TX (~400 attendees).

2023

Vibecamp 2

Moved to Camp Ramblewood, MD.

2024

Vibecamp 3 & Vibeclipse

Hosted the third main camp, plus a special "Vibeclipse" event in Texas for the solar eclipse.

2025

Vibecamp 4

Returned to Camp Ramblewood from June 19–22 for its fourth annual gathering.

2026

Vibecamp 5 ("Fivecamp")

Upcoming fifth-anniversary event slated for June 18–21 at Camp Ramblewood.

name: Zanzalu
description:
Zanzalu is a living lab and annual popup city in Fumba Town, Zanzibar. Builders, technologists, and innovators gather for three weeks to test ideas in real time, form high-trust networks, and experiment with technology, governance, and culture. The event blends focused programming with unstructured time in a walkable waterfront community complete with coworking, housing, and amenities.

The long-term goal is a permanent innovation hub in Fumba Town that supports year-round residencies and community events.

Zu-Grama is built on three core pillars: living together at a human scale with ambitious builders, developing frontier tech the d/acc way (spanning AI, crypto, biotech, and governance), and utilizing these tools by default.

Zuitzerland is a Zuzalu-inspired sandbox located in Switzerland. It organizes popup villages with a focus on defensive accelerationism (d/acc) principles.

name: Zuzalu
description:
Zuzalu was a two-month experimental popup city in Montenegro created by Vitalik Buterin and a small team. It brought together ~200 builders, thinkers, and researchers in longevity, crypto, AI, and network states for coliving and collaboration.

After the original event, Zuzalu decentralized into independently-run Zu-villages, supported by two Gitcoin funding rounds for both events and core infrastructure like Zupass.

Zuzalu is especially important because it minted the popup village model that provided a concrete organizational form to the network state movement.

sourceText:
Zuzalu - Ethereum popup village network
Zuzalu

An umbrella community of popup villages anchored to the Ethereum community.

Learn more
About Zuzalu

Zuzalu was a two-month experimental popup city in Montenegro created by Vitalik Buterin and a small team. It brought together ~200 builders, thinkers, and researchers in longevity, crypto, AI, and network states for coliving and collaboration.

After the original event, Zuzalu decentralized into independently-run Zu-villages, supported by two Gitcoin funding rounds for both events and core infrastructure like Zupass.

Zuzalu is especially important because it minted the popup village model that provided a concrete organizational form to the network state movement.

20+
Popup Villages
500 ETH
Deployed into popups
10+
Countries
Posts
Frequently asked questions
What was Zuzalu's original mission?
When and where did the original Zuzalu happen?
What was ZuConnect?
What happened after the original events?
Who it's for
Ethereum builders
Longevity builders
Governance nerds
Founders
Timeline
Mar–May 2023

Zuzalu Popup City

Vitalik Buterin launched the first 2-month popup city in Montenegro (~200 attendees) focused on crypto, AI, and longevity.

Oct–Nov 2023

ZuConnect Istanbul

A 2-week gathering (~300 attendees) featuring the community's first funding round.

Dec 2023

Decentralization Moment

Vitalik proposed a shift from centralized events to independent, global popup villages.

Jan–Feb 2024

Zuzalu Funding Round 1 (Events)

Gitcoin deployed a 166 ETH pool to fund new village locations.

Jan–Feb 2024

Zuzalu Funding Round 2 (Technology)

Gitcoin deployed an 83 ETH pool to fund tools and core infrastructure.

Oct 2024

Popup Archipelago

A new popup event in Chiang Mai expanded the independent village network.

sections.About Zuzalu:
About Zuzalu

Zuzalu was a two-month experimental popup city in Montenegro created by Vitalik Buterin and a small team. It brought together ~200 builders, thinkers, and researchers in longevity, crypto, AI, and network states for coliving and collaboration.

After the original event, Zuzalu decentralized into independently-run Zu-villages, supported by two Gitcoin funding rounds for both events and core infrastructure like Zupass.

Zuzalu is especially important because it minted the popup village model that provided a concrete organizational form to the network state movement.
